routing.operation: Saw cut bar to length 190 mm
CNC turning op 1 (chuck side) + centre holes DIN 332-D M8
CNC turning op 2 (finish contour + thread M20×1.5)
Cylindrical grinding 2× Ø25 h6 + Ø40 m6, between centres
routing.basis: PM-SH-2214 (2 seats) + 25% for third ground seat

routing.operation: Demagnetize, final inspection, 100% runout check A–B

recommended_plant.why: Identical spline hob (W30×1.5, from PM-SH-2214) and induction hardening in-house; customer proximity for first-article approval. Re-evaluate Poland transfer at the 500 pcs/yr scenario — grinding capacity is available there (PM-SH-1876 line) at ~18% lower conversion cost.

critical_ops_notes: GRD-05 is the bottleneck (7.4 min/pc); runout 0.02 A–B demands between-centres grinding of all three seats in one clamping
Grind AFTER induction hardening; keep hardened zone clear of the Ø40 m6 shoulder to avoid grinding burns
Total machine time ≈ 30.9 min/pc, plus setups amortized over the release lot
open_questions: Confirm IH-01 inductor coil fits the 45 mm spline section — geometry differs slightly from PM-SH-2214; worst case a new coil (~€1,800, 3 wks)
